purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical receipt (レセプト) printing/configuration settings for the JMA ORCA medical billing system, specifically the W12 screen for receipt print information settings
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It handles system management information settings related to receipt printing (レセプト印刷情報), including disease name classification, transfer classification, national health insurance/social insurance receipt classification, printer settings, and related configuration options. It appears to be a screen-based configuration program managing SPA (screen parameter area) data for receipt output settings.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (42 copybooks)
SPA (Screen Parameter Area) pattern typical of ORCA window-based programs
OCCURS clauses for classification list arrays
No COMP-3 usage despite financial domain
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS (uses ORCA middleware instead)
WRK-MCP-WIDGET field suggesting MCP/GTK widget integration
